snippet.title: XZAP - Game Boy Color Homebrew
snippet.description:
Originally developed by Mark Wirt and published by Commodore Business Machines for the Commodore 16/Plus4 in 1984, this is an all new GBC port developed by Rajcsányi László (WLS), created using the popular GB Studio.

You are a lone XZAPPER, last survivor of an advanced civilisation.Many centuries ago, your planet was besieged by alien hordes. Now only you remain. The aliens have the advantage of numbers, but you are on home territory. Your mission is to collect energy berries left on the tracks and complete all 12 levels.

The game was probably never released independently, only as part of a collection that came with the Commodore 16. Specifically, it was part of  "The Commodore 16 Showcase", which was included in the C16 Starter Pack. The GameBoy version does not follow the original game where you have to shoot. In this version you have to collect points, but the graphics solutions are very similar.

Download the game from his website: https://www.wls.hu/
Itch.io Link: https://lacoste42.itch.io/xzap
